Switch client.py so the query goes through URL parameters, leave the timeout as-is, and run sh ./fb3-04-gate.sh

content:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: widget catalog
  version: "1.2.0"
paths:
  /widgets/search:
    post:
      operationId: widget_search
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                q:
                  type: string
      responses:
        "200":
          description: hits

evidence: openapi.yaml declares /widgets/search under `post` with required JSON requestBody; no `get` entry exists.

If openapi.yaml is to stay as-is, either the spec or the client needs correcting; I have not modified the spec.
arguments.recommended_action: Confirm whether widget_search is actually GET-only or POST; if GET-only, update openapi.yaml to declare a `get` operation with `q` as a query parameter so spec and client agree.
